rationale: With only 3 minutes remaining before the mandatory market-on-close liquidation, there is insufficient time for a new trade thesis to develop and overcome the 9.2 bps bid-ask spread. Although SLM is experiencing heavy late-day selling pressure on rising 1-minute volume toward its session low of $21.58, initiating a position right before closing auction imbalances introduces unfavorable execution risk and a compressed reward-to-risk ratio.
